# FLKRD MOVIES

Interactive Kurdish translation and subtitle streaming platform for movies and TV series.

## Main Navigation Paths
- [/](/): Explore popular, trending, and top rated movies & TV series.
- [/discover](/discover): Filter by genre, language, country, and release year.
- [/search](/search): Real-time lookup for titles, actors, or directors.
- [/dubbed](/dubbed): Kurdish dubbed movies and video audio feeds.
- [/continue-watching](/continue-watching): Resume progress on unfinished content.
- [/mylist](/mylist): View personal watchlist.
- [/kurdish-cc](/kurdish-cc): Check list of custom-translated subtitle registry.
